title: Technology Through Time
content:
When Emma was a child, technology was very different.

Years ago, her family **used** a large computer at home. They **watched** movies on DVDs and **talked** to friends using a landline phone.

Emma **didn't have** a smartphone, and the internet **was** much slower.

She remembers that people **sent** emails from their computers and **waited** for important messages.

“But technology has changed a lot,” Emma says.

Today, Emma **uses** her smartphone for almost everything.

She **sends** messages, **makes** video calls, listens to music, and watches movies online.

Her home also **has** smart devices. Her voice assistant **controls** the lights, and her smartwatch **tracks** her daily activity.

“Technology makes many things easier,” she says.

But Emma often thinks about the future.

In the next few years, technology **will become** even more advanced.

People **will use** smarter artificial intelligence, and homes **will become** more connected.

Cars **will drive** themselves, and virtual reality **will create** new ways to work, study, and travel.

Maybe robots **will help** people with their daily tasks.

Emma doesn't know exactly what the future **will look like**.

But she knows one thing.

Technology **changed** the past, **changes** the present, and **will change** the future.

And every generation will have a different story to tell.
